faq:
Frequently Asked Questions

Do you work as a salon interior designer in Karnal?

Yes. We design new salons and refits in Karnal, and site visits are planned through the project so the work on the ground follows the drawings.

What areas does a salon layout include?

Reception, waiting area, styling stations, wash basins, colour bar, treatment or spa rooms, staff area and storage. Each area is sized for your services and team.

Can a salon be designed in phases?

Yes. If you are starting small, we can plan the full layout now and build it in stages, so later additions fit without rework.

Why hire a salon interior designer for a growing city like Karnal?

Clients in Karnal now expect the same polish they see in Delhi and Chandigarh salons. A well-planned interior helps a new salon look established from the first day.
